issues.description: Timer-based bookend races with stream-completion path, breaking Start/End invariant
issues.detail: Two notions of 'response over' (1.0s timeout task and end-of-stream) share one mutable boolean _output_response_open with no lock. The timeout can fire End mid-await on Start/Text frames, producing End-before-Text, double-End, or interleaved bookends. Drop the timer: emit Start before loop, Text inside, End after. One concept, no race.

issues.description: default_response_to_output_transformer raises on non-JSON lines, aborting the stream and corrupting state
issues.detail: json.loads is called with no try/except. A heartbeat, keepalive, or malformed SSE line raises JSONDecodeError out of process_frame, leaving _output_response_open=True with a dangling close task and no matching End frame. Guard the parse and return None on failure, or document transformers must be total.

issues.description: bedrock-agentcore client is reconstructed per LLMContextFrame on the hot path
issues.detail: async with self._aws_session.client(...) inside process_frame creates a new client for every invocation, paying TLS handshake, credential resolution, and connection setup on each turn. This is per-turn latency the user feels. Cache the client in setup()/start() and reuse across invocations.

issues.description: Hand-rolled SSE parsing uses hardcoded offsets and naive newline split
issues.detail: Code splits on '\n' (mishandling '\r\n'), checks 'data: ' prefix with a magic slice [6:], and warns on conforming SSE features (id:, event:, comments, blank-line frame boundaries). Wire framing and content extraction are complected. Decompose into a small lines->events function plus a transformer, or use an SSE parser.

issues.description: agentArn parameter violates PEP 8 and the surrounding API's snake_case convention
issues.detail: Every other constructor kwarg is snake_case (aws_access_key, aws_region); agentArn is camelCase because it mirrors the boto field. The boto naming is an incidental transport detail and should not leak into the public API. Rename to agent_arn (and _agent_arn) before shipping; map to agentRuntimeArn at the boto call site.

issues.description: Default context transformer silently drops non-text multimodal parts
issues.detail: When content is a list, part.get('text', '') is joined across all parts. Image, tool-result, or malformed parts contribute empty strings, producing payloads of stray spaces with no warning. State the spec: either filter to text parts explicitly, log when non-text parts are dropped, or refuse malformed input.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the processor's bones are reasonable but its streaming state machine is unreasoned and under-specified. The central defect is a race between a 1.0s timeout-driven End frame and the deterministic end-of-stream path, both mutating _output_response_open without synchronization — the Start/End bookend invariant is neither stated nor preserved across timers, exceptions, or malformed lines. Secondary issues cluster around an unguarded json.loads in the default transformer, hand-rolled SSE parsing with magic offsets, and a per-turn boto client construction that wastes the one optimization worth making. Naming discipline (agentArn) breaks the public API convention and should be fixed before this ships. Verdict: needs rework on the bookend and transformer contracts before merge.
